cohort: The study included 681 pregnant women aged 17-42 years who attended the pregnancy follow-up polyclinic at Sakarya Training and Research Hospital.
finding: The study revealed that the overall level of knowledge on childbirth among pregnant women was low, varied significantly with socio-demographic and obstetric characteristics, and had a very weak relationship with fear of childbirth.
mod_finding: Women who had given birth with Caesarean section previously demonstrated a higher level of knowledge on childbirth.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, from December 2015 to April 2016
